title: Coherent Feedback Cooling of an Ultracoherent Phononic-Crystal Membrane at Room Temperature
summary: Optomechanical systems provide a versatile platform for precision measurements and investigations of fundamental physics, where bringing macroscopic resonators into the quantum regime is a widely pursued goal. Achieving such quantum behavior of solid-state mechanical resonators at room temperature would greatly broaden their applications by removing the need for cryogenic environments.
